original.statement: The -tsdb.shipper.shared-store option is removed; if its value differed from object_store for a tsdb period, the index for that period becomes inaccessible until index tables are moved or copied to the object_store store.

decision.reason: The upgrade guide says the CLI flags for the TSDB and BoltDB shipper shared store, along with their YAML settings, "are now removed" [ev-43cc6d389282]. It lists `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` among them [ev-15a875cd9a39]. The cited item calls it "the deleted configuration option" [ev-af5a4b32c120]. So the subject (the cli-flag, spelled with the single dash used in the text) and the change type `removed` are both stated directly.
